name: pot_vote
description: Fishers and elder vote on how to split the communal pot.

prompt.template: The communal pot contains {balance_kg:.2f}kg of fish. Propose a split: how many kg should go to immediate community needs (e.g., fuel, net repair) and how many kg to reserve for emergencies. Respond with JSON: {"immediate_kg": <number>, "reserve_kg": <number>}. The sum must equal the pot balance.
